questions.question: The quarterly financial report has been delayed ______ the unexpected server outage.
questions.explanation: 考点：原因介词。due to 表原因后接名词短语，意为“由于”，选B。

questions.question: All employees are required to submit ______ expense claims by Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 考点：代词。修饰名词 expense claims 需用形容词性物主代词 their。

questions.question: Mr. Harrison will lead the marketing team ______ Ms. Davis is on maternity leave.
questions.explanation: 考点：时间连词。while 引导时间状语从句，表示“在……期间”，选A。

questions.question: The newly hired receptionist answered the telephone calls very ______.
questions.explanation: 考点：词性辨析。修饰动词 answered 需用副词 professionally，选C。

questions.question: To improve client satisfaction, our support staff responds to inquiries ______.
questions.explanation: 考点：副词。修饰动词 responds 需用副词 promptly，选C。

questions.question: Candidates for the managerial position must have extensive experience ______ project management.
questions.explanation: 考点：介词搭配。experience in 表示“在某领域的经验”，选A。

questions.question: The safety inspection of the manufacturing plant ______ scheduled for next Monday.
questions.explanation: 考点：主谓一致。主语 inspection 为单数，被动语态用 is，选A。

questions.question: Ms. Tanaka reviewed the architectural blueprints ______ before submitting them to the client.
questions.explanation: 考点：副词。修饰动词 reviewed 需用副词 carefully，选C。

questions.question: Please ensure that all office equipment is turned off ______ you leave the building.
questions.explanation: 考点：时间连词。before 引导状语从句，表示“在……之前”，选A。

questions.question: The CEO announced that the company will launch its new service line ______ next year.
questions.explanation: 考点：副词。early next year 为固定时间短语，表示“明年初”，选A。

questions.question: Mr. Vance decided to invest in the software startup ______ its high growth potential.
questions.explanation: 考点：介词短语。because of 后接名词短语表原因，选B。

questions.question: Anyone ______ wishes to attend the annual workshop must register by Friday.
questions.explanation: 考点：定语从句。先行词 Anyone 指人且从句缺主语，用 who，选A。

questions.question: The human resources department will distribute the updated employee handbook ______.
questions.explanation: 考点：副词。shortly 意为“不久，很快”，用于将来时态，选B。

questions.question: Dr. Henderson is known ______ her outstanding contributions to medical research.
questions.explanation: 考点：固定搭配。be known for 表示“因……而闻名”，选A。

questions.question: To maintain product quality, all factory items are inspected ______ before packaging.
questions.explanation: 考点：副词。修饰被动语态 are inspected 需用副词 rigorously，选C。

questions.question: Mr. Lopez has been working at Apex Corporation ______ he graduated from university.
questions.explanation: 考点：时态搭配。since 引导时间状语从句，与现在完成进行时连用，选B。

questions.question: The conference room on the third floor is ______ for the board meeting this afternoon.
questions.explanation: 考点：被动语态。is 后接过去分词 reserved 表状态“已被预订”，选B。

questions.question: Clients who require technical assistance can contact ______ help desk at any time.
questions.explanation: 考点：代词。修饰名词 help desk 需用形容词性物主代词 our，选C。

questions.question: The management team evaluated several proposals ______ selecting the lowest bidder.
questions.explanation: 考点：连词 before + -ing。before selecting 表示“在选定之前”，选A。

questions.question: Our research indicates that consumer demand for eco-friendly products is growing ______.
questions.explanation: 考点：副词。修饰动词 is growing 需用副词 steadily，选C。

questions.question: The accounting department requested ______ all receipts be submitted by Friday.
questions.explanation: 考点：虚拟语气。request 后接 that 从句用 (should) do 虚拟，选A。

questions.question: Mr. Chen was promoted to senior manager ______ his outstanding leadership skills.
questions.explanation: 考点：原因介词。due to 后接名词短语表原因，选B。

questions.question: The company provides comprehensive orientation sessions to all ______ employees.
questions.explanation: 考点：形容词。修饰名词 employees 需用形容词 new，选A。

questions.question: Ms. Green will supervise the installation of the new software system ______.
questions.explanation: 考点：副词。personally 意为“亲自”，修饰动词 supervise，选C。

questions.question: The shuttle bus to the downtown station departs ______ every twenty minutes.
questions.explanation: 考点：副词。修饰时间短语 every twenty minutes 需用副词 approximately，选A。

questions.question: All visitors must wear their identification badges ______ they are inside the facility.
questions.explanation: 考点：时间连词。while 引导时间状语从句，表示“当……的时候”，选A。

questions.question: The software update improves security features and enhances overall system ______.
questions.explanation: 考点：名词。形容词整体修饰，句末需名词作宾语，选B。

questions.question: Please submit your travel expense report ______ the end of the month.
questions.explanation: 考点：介词。by 表示“在……之前”，与截止期限连用，选A。

questions.question: The director praised the project team for completing the work ______ schedule.
questions.explanation: 考点：固定搭配。ahead of schedule 意为“提前”，选A。

questions.question: The seminar on effective business communication is open to all ______ employees.
questions.explanation: 考点：分词形容词。interested 修饰人，意为“感兴趣的”，选B。

questions.question: Mr. Roberts asked ______ the shipment would arrive before the weekend.
questions.explanation: 考点：宾语从句。ask 后接 whether/if 表“是否”，选A。

questions.question: The manufacturing plant operates ______ to meet the high seasonal demand.
questions.explanation: 考点：副词。修饰动词 operates 需用副词 continually（持续地），选B。

questions.question: Employees are advised to read the updated security guidelines ______.
questions.explanation: 考点：副词。修饰动词 read 需用副词 carefully，选C。

questions.question: The company has experienced ______ growth in online sales over the past year.
questions.explanation: 考点：形容词。修饰名词 growth 需用形容词 significant，选A。

questions.question: Ms. Larson is responsible ______ coordinating the annual company retreat.
questions.explanation: 考点：固定搭配。be responsible for 意为“负责……”，选A。

questions.question: The building manager announced that the elevators will be out of service ______ routine maintenance.
questions.explanation: 考点：介词。for 后接名词短语表原因/目的，指维护期间停运，选A。

questions.question: To qualify for the discount, customers must enter the promo code ______ checkout.
questions.explanation: 考点：介词固定搭配。at checkout 意为“在结账时”，选A。

questions.question: The marketing director presented a ______ strategy for the upcoming product launch.
questions.explanation: 考点：形容词。修饰名词 strategy 需用形容词 comprehensive，选A。

questions.question: All staff members are required to attend the safety briefing ______ in the main auditorium.
questions.explanation: 考点：过去分词作后置定语。held 表被动“举行的会议”，选C。
